summary.text: Dawn Gillman is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 17A since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes owning a business and working as a communications consultant.

paragraphs.text: Dawn Gillman's career experience includes owning a business and working as a communications consultant.
She took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 3, 2023, succeeding Tim Miller, and she advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
